rules: Wrapper 许可与 native 许可分行记录；POM 或 wrapper LICENSE 不覆盖内嵌二进制。
SOURCE_AVAILABLE 不等于已生成 SOURCE_OFFER；COMPONENT_LICENSE_FOUND 不等于 NOTICE_COMPLETE。
本矩阵是工程义务映射，不是法律意见；最终分发路线须复核。

rows.noticeObligation: Distribute the Apache-2.0 license text; if a NOTICE exists for the distributed component, reproduce applicable notices. No root NOTICE file was found at this tag.
rows.sourceOfferObligation: Apache-2.0 does not itself require a copyleft source offer; keep the pinned source URL for audit and reproducibility.
rows.relinkBoundary: No LGPL relink obligation from this component.
